assets.name: picture
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production settings-menu icon for a cheerful Mario Party 6 native port.
Style: polished hand-illustrated glossy 3D cartoon, chunky rounded toy-like bevels, saturated colors, smooth clean surfaces, warm upper-left highlights, simple silhouette readable at 40 pixels. Joyful Nintendo-era party-game aesthetic, not a flat glyph or photoreal object.
Composition: exactly one centered icon on a square canvas, entire silhouette visible, icon fills about 82% of the canvas, balanced transparent padding. Genuine transparent background. No backdrop, panel, checkerboard, ground plane, cast ground shadow, text, letters, numbers, watermark, or additional decorative objects.
Subject: A thick golden rounded picture frame, slightly three dimensional but facing the viewer, containing a simple blue sky, green hills and one white cloud. A small gold five-point star is integrated into the frame's top center. Bright inviting video settings symbol.
